methodology.matching: Per-frame global maximum-cardinality, maximum-IoU assignment of currently observed tracker boxes to independently generated truth boxes; IoU >= 0.5. Lost tracks are not observations.
methodology.identity_switches: A truth identity receives a different tracker ID from its last matched observation, including after a gap. Counts are ground-truth based, unlike live potential_id_switches.
methodology.fragmentations: A previously matched truth identity becomes unmatched and later matched again while still in the scenario. Expected missing detections count too.
methodology.timing: Source sequences identical; one untimed evaluation plus 5 timing repetitions per tracker, after eight warm-up updates. perf_counter_ns brackets update() only; excludes detection, evaluation, rendering and HTTP. Mean/P95 pool update durations; P95 uses linear interpolation. Baseline runs first; thermal/scheduler/order effects remain.
methodology.limitations: Synthetic boxes and scripted omissions only; no detector, physical camera, labeled real footage, appearance re-identification or real-world accuracy claim. IDF1 is not implemented. Baseline suspicion counters are unavailable and reported as zero. Long-occlusion ID replacement is expected. Ambiguous synthetic overlap can remain unresolved even with a stable ID.

scenarios.name: constant_motion
scenarios.description: One box at a constant 40 pixels/source-second.

scenarios.name: parallel_vehicles
scenarios.description: Two nearby same-class vehicles with equal motion and distinct boxes.

scenarios.name: crossing_paths
scenarios.description: Opposing vehicles cross with an 8-pixel vertical offset; no exact duplicate boxes.

scenarios.name: short_occlusion
scenarios.description: One vehicle has four missing detections, shorter than the one-second TTL.

scenarios.name: long_occlusion
scenarios.description: Twelve missing detections exceed TTL; a new ID is expected on return.

scenarios.name: box_jitter
scenarios.description: Deterministic contact-point jitter up to five pixels around true motion.

scenarios.name: different_speeds
scenarios.description: A faster vehicle overtakes a slower vehicle with a small lane offset.

scenarios.name: irregular_timestamps
scenarios.description: Constant motion sampled at irregular source intervals; no FPS substitution.

scenarios.name: ambiguous_overlap
scenarios.description: Closely overlapping opposing boxes with intermittent detections and jitter.

scenarios.name: entry_exit
scenarios.description: Distinct objects enter and exit; absence is not treated as a continuing identity.

scenarios.name: greedy_counterexample
scenarios.description: Two feasible matches exist, but the original best-edge-first strategy loses one.
